subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: I can spell Unit 1 words in a crossword.
I can read a secret code question and answer.
I can play a board game and talk about my routines.

tf.s: In the secret code, 5 means the letter a.
tf.why: Yes! 5 = a, so Wh5t is What.

tf.s: In the secret code, 6 means the letter u.
The numbers in the code take the place of the vowels.
tf.why: Great! a, e, i, o and u are numbers.

tf.s: After I get up, I pray.
tf.why: That is a crossword clue: pray.

tf.s: The code 2 h5v4 d2nn4r means I have dinner.
In the code, 2 means the letter e.
In the board game, Miss a turn means you wait.
tf.why: You don't play in the next turn.

tf.s: The crossword clue says I have dinner at two o'clock.
tf.why: The clue is I have lunch at two o'clock.

boxes.q: Clue: After I get up, I p____.
boxes.why: After we get up, we pray.

boxes.q: What do the numbers in the code replace?
boxes.why: The numbers replace a, e, i, o and u.

mcq.q: Which numbers stand for vowels in the code?

mcq.q: Read the code: Wh5t t2m4 d6 y63 h5v4 d2nn4r?
o: What time do you have dinner?
What time do you have lunch?
mcq.why: Change each number to its vowel.

mcq.q: Read the code: 2 h5v4 d2nn4r 5t s4v4n 6'cl6ck.
o: I have dinner at seven o'clock.
I have dinner at six o'clock.
I have lunch at seven o'clock.
I go to bed at seven o'clock.

mcq.why: E is 4, so When is Wh4n.

mcq.q: Write go to bed in the code.
Why can we still read the code?
o: Only the vowels change; the other letters stay.
mcq.why: The other letters help us read the word.

mcq.q: Which is the code for the word pray?
mcq.why: Pray has the vowel a, and a is 5.
